name: APFSDS M829A3 (USA, 120 mm)
description: US 120 mm round (M1 Abrams). Depleted-uranium main rod about 670 mm long, 25 mm thick, ~1555 m/s. The real round also has a 100 mm steel tip section in front (meant to set off reactive armour) - not modelled. Depleted uranium is not in the simulator yet: modelled as tungsten alloy (6% lighter). Figures are public estimates.
